name: @latticekit/showcase-emberwake
description: EMBERWAKE — a fast isometric night raid built only from @latticekit/*. The flagship showcase: what the kit can do with no line limit.
$comment: A workspace member: the root package.json lists `showcase/*`, so @latticekit/* resolve to `packages/` through the root node_modules symlinks rather than to the registry. That is deliberate — a showcase silently testing the last published tarball would prove nothing about the tree it lives in, and in this repository the registry copies are known to lag. Run `npm run build` at the root first, because the symlinks point at each package dist.
